description: This Java source file implements the <add-error> element of the MiniLang language within the OFBiz framework. It defines the AddError class, which handles adding error messages to a list in a method context at runtime, and contains validation logic, execution logic, and a factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: AddError
classes.description: Represents the <add-error> element, responsible for adding error messages to a designated list within the method context during execution.

classes.name: AddError.AddErrorFactory
classes.description: Factory class for instantiating AddError objects based on XML element input.

methods.name: AddError
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AddError object by parsing attributes and child elements from the XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation by retrieving message content and appending it to the error list in the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the AddError instance, mainly for debugging.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create an AddError instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation element, i.e., 'add-error'.
